about: Digitraffic (Fintraffic) offers open, real-time Finnish road, rail and marine traffic data. This CLI wraps its public JSON APIs (tie/rata/meri.digitraffic.fi), the status page and the announcements (tiedotteet) pages.

commands.summary: List Digitraffic announcements (tiedotteet), newest first. You can filter by traffic type or tag.
Get the full text of one announcement by date and slug, as found in the URL /tiedotteet/YYYY/MM/DD/slug.html.
Get the current status (ok/disrupted/down) of every Digitraffic API system.
List incidents on the status page (outages, disruptions), newest first, with their resolution state.
List current road traffic messages (announcements, road works, weight restrictions, exempted transports) as GeoJSON features.

params.name: inactiveHours
params.description: Also include messages that ended within this many hours

commands.summary: Get one road traffic message by its situationId, e.g. GUID50xxxxxx (take the id from list-traffic-messages).
Get the latest sensor readings from all road weather stations.
Get the latest sensor readings (air/road temperature, wind, etc.) for one road weather station.
Get live traffic measurement data (vehicle counts, average speeds) for one TMS station.
List all road weather camera stations, with location and state.
Get one weather camera station by id, including camera presets and image URLs.
Get the latest road maintenance tracking points (snow ploughing, salting, etc.) as GeoJSON.

params.name: taskId
params.description: Filter by maintenance task, e.g. PLOUGHING_AND_SLUSH_REMOVAL, SALTING

commands.summary: List live trains arriving at and departing from a railway station, by station short code (e.g. HKI, TPE).

params.name: station
params.description: Station short code, e.g. HKI (Helsinki), TPE (Tampere)

params.name: include_nonstopping
params.description: Include trains that pass without stopping

commands.summary: List the next trains running from one station to another, by station short codes.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of trains (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.summary: Get one train's timetable and live status by departure date (or 'latest') and train number.
Get a train's composition (locomotives, wagons, length, max speed) by departure date and train number.
List all railway stations with short codes, names, UIC codes and coordinates.
Get the latest GPS location and speed of every running train.
Get the latest AIS vessel positions (GeoJSON). You can filter by MMSI or by a radius around a point.

params.name: latitude
params.description: Center latitude for a radius search

params.name: longitude
params.description: Center longitude for a radius search

params.name: from
params.description: Only positions updated after this epoch milliseconds

commands.summary: Get AIS vessel metadata (name, call sign, IMO, ship type, destination) by MMSI.
List port calls (vessel arrivals and departures) for a port, by UN/LOCODE (e.g. FIHEL).
Get the latest sea state estimation (SSE) measurements from coastal sites: wind, wave, sea state.
List current faults in aids to navigation (buoys, lights, beacons) in Finnish waters.

params.name: fixed
params.description: Return only fixed (true) or only unfixed (false) faults
